title: Hardy-Rogers and Jungck Type Fixed Point Theorems in Perturbed Metric Spaces, Stability and Data Dependence
summary: In this paper we establish Hardy-Rogers and Jungck type fixed point theorems in perturbed metric spaces, where the observed distance $D$ is separated from the exact metric $d$ by a nonnegative perturbation $P$. Rather than the uniform absorption of $P$ by $d$ required under domination, we examine a weaker demand, imposed only on the pairs of points that appear with a contractive coefficient. We show that without some such condition, and without a continuity hypothesis on $T$, a perturbed Banach contraction on a complete perturbed metric space may fail to have a fixed point.
